The wall

The wall is the line between the world and the company. Ground truth never crosses it; everything else is an interface flow, in one of two directions. The test on every line of the company’s code: could a real supplier know this?

Read each column top to bottom as a list, not a chain. The mark in each box is read from the maturity map at publish: . done, _ in build, ~ not started.

Where to see it working

  • Capabilities — what the company does with each flow that crosses.
  • How it’s built — the verifier and the rules that keep the wall shut.
  • Explore — one household as the company sees it.
  • The code — the seam itself, and the adapters on it.
